'''HiBob''' is a [[Human resource management|human resources]] software company that develops Bob, a cloud-based human capital management platform. The company was founded in [[Tel Aviv]] in 2015 by Amit Knaani, Ronni Zehavi, Israel David, and Andy Bellass, and is headquartered in [[London]].<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/hibob/ |title=HiBob profile |website=Forbes}}</ref> HiBob has raised several rounds of venture funding, including a US$150 million Series C in 2021 and a US$150 million funding round in 2023 that valued the company at nearly US$2.7 billion.<ref name=":0"/><ref name="Sawers2022"/>The company expanded its platform through the acquisitions of payroll automation company Pento in 2024 and financial planning and analysis platform Mosaic in 2025.

==History==
HiBob was founded in 2015 in [[Tel Aviv]] by Amit Knaani, Ronni Zehavi, Israel David, and Andy Bellass to develop [[human resources]] [[software]] intended for internationally [[remote work|distributed workforces]].<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/rkaehmmyyx|title=Unicorn HiBob awards stock options to reservist employees who served in the war|date=February 6, 2025 |first=Meir |last=Orbach |website=[[Calcalist]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250218065928/https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/rkaehmmyyx|archive-date=2025-02-18}}</ref> Early funding came from U.S.-based [[venture capital firm]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thetimes.com/business-money/money/article/staff-need-to-feel-that-a-pension-is-their-money-b59xqc7b0|title=‘Staff need to feel that a pension is their money’|first=James|last=Hurley|date=August 1, 2016|website=[[The Times]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.standard.co.uk/business/startup-hibob-raises-another-ps14-million-for-hr-platform-a3523051.html|title=Start-up HiBob raises another £14 million for HR platform|first=Jamie|last=Nimmo|date=April 25, 2017|website=[[Evening Standard]]}}</ref>

In 2016, HiBob launched its platform in the [[United Kingdom]].<ref name=":2" /> A year later, in 2017, it received $17.5 million in a [[Series A]] funding round.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Rath |first=Julien |title=HR startup hibob raised $17.5 million to expand its operations globally |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/hr-startup-hibob-raised-175-million-to-expand-its-operations-globally-2017-4 |access-date=2026-05-25 |website=Business Insider |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="Sawers2017">{{Cite web|url=https://venturebeat.com/entrepreneur/hibob-raises-17-5-million/|title=London-based Hibob raises $17.5 million to expand its HR platform into the U.S. and other markets |date=April 25, 2017 |first=Paul |last=Sawers |website=[[VentureBeat]]}}</ref> In 2019, it received additional funding of $20 million.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-03-13 |title=Israeli HR tech firm Hibob raises $20 million |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/technology/israeli-hr-tech-firm-hibob-raises-20-million-idUSKBN1QU1V4/ |website=Reuters}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://venturebeat.com/ai/hibob-raises-20-million-to-modernize-hr-with-digital-tools/|title=Hibob raises $20 million to modernize HR with digital tools |first=Kyle |last= Wiggers |date=March 13, 2019 |website=[[VentureBeat]]}}</ref>

In 2020, HiBob raised $70 million in [[Series B]] funding; by late 2020 it had raised approximately US$124 million in venture capital funding.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/newyork/news/2020/12/10/tribeca-based-human-resources-software-firm-raises.html|title=Hibob, an HR technology company, has raised $70 million |first=Ben |last=Miller |date=December 10, 2020 |website=[[New York Business Journal]]}}</ref><ref name="Sawers2020">{{Cite web|url=https://venturebeat.com/business/hibob-raises-70-million-to-expand-its-data-driven-hr-platform-to-more-markets/|title=Hibob raises $70 million to expand its data-driven HR platform to more markets |date=December 10, 2020 |first=Paul |last=Sawers |website=[[VentureBeat]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2020/12/10/hibob-raises-70m-on-a-500m-valuation-for-its-new-take-on-hr/|title=Hibob raises $70M for its new take on human resources|first=Ingrid|last=Lunden|date=December 10, 2020|website=[[TechCrunch]]}}</ref> Following this round, the company expanded hiring in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Glover |first=Ellen |date=2020-12-10 |title=Hibob Raises $70M to Reimagine HR Tech Amid Remote Work Boom {{!}} Built In NYC |url=https://www.builtinnyc.com/articles/hibob-raises-70m-hiring |access-date=2026-05-25 |website=Built In NYC |language=en}}</ref>

HiBob then raised US$150 million in [[Venture round|Series C]] funding in October 2021, followed by another US$150 million Series D round in August 2022.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-hr-management-co-hibob-raises-150m-at-165b-valuation-1001387014|title=HR management co Hibob raises $150m at $1.65b valuation|date=December 10, 2021|first=Ofir |last=Dor|via=[[Globes (newspaper)|Globes]]}}</ref> The rounds valued the company at US$1.65 billion and US$2.45 billion, respectively.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2021/10/13/hr-platform-hibob-raises-150m-at-a-1-65b-valuation/|title=HR platform Hibob raises $150M at a $1.65B valuation|first=Ingrid|last=Lunden|date=October 13, 2021 |website=[[TechCrunch]]}}</ref><ref name="Sawers2022">{{Cite web|url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/08/17/hr-startup-hibobs-valuation-surges-50-to-2-45b-on-a-150m-raise/|title=HR startup HiBob's valuation surges to $2.45B on $150M raise|first=Paul|last=Sawers|date=August 17, 2022 |website=[[TechCrunch]]}}</ref>  Another US$150 million funding round occurred in September 2023, led by [[Farallon Capital]] and Alpha Wave Global, raising HiBob's valuation to nearly US$2.7 billion and bringing total funding to approximately US$574 million.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.calcalist.co.il/calcalistech/article/hkspd68ka |title=חברת HiBob גייסה 150 מיליון דולר לפי שווי של 2.7 מיליארד דולר: "מוכנים להנפקה" &#124; כלכליסט |trans-title=HiBob raises $150 million at $2.7 billion valuation |date=September 19, 2023 |first=Meir |last=Auerbach |website=[[Calcalist]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/tech-and-start-ups/article-760127|title=Israeli human resources company HiBob secures $150 mil. in extra funding|date=September 22, 2023|website=[[The Jerusalem Post]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-09-19/hedge-fund-farallon-leads-funding-round-valuing-hibob-at-2-7-billion|title=Hedge Fund Farallon Leads Funding Round Valuing HiBob at $2.7 Billion|first= Hema |last=Parmar |date=September 19, 2023 |website=[[Bloomberg.com|Bloomberg]]}}</ref>

In 2021, HiBob acquired Cassiopeia and subsequently integrated its anonymous reporting tool, Your Voice, into the HiBob platform.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hcamag.com/us/hr-software-reviews/hibob-review/444700|title=HiBob Review |first=Ada |last=Tabanao |date=May 3, 2023 |website=HRD}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cmswire.com/digital-workplace/hr-platform-hibob-acquires-cassiopeia-to-support-remote-and-hybrid-work/|title=HR Platform Hibob Acquires Cassiopeia to Support Remote and Hybrid Work |first=Mike |last=Prokopeak |date=June 9, 2021 |website=CMSWire}}</ref> In 2022, the company acquired Bugle, a [[Lisbon]]-based company, and established a research and development center in Portugal.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/sydtsqezs|title=HiBob acquires Portuguese company Bugle, sets up R&D center in Lisbon|first=Meir |last=Orbach|date=September 15, 2022|website=[[Calcalist]]}}</ref>

In November 2022, ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' selected HiBob for its annual "200 Best Inventions" list.<ref name="TIME">{{Cite web|url=https://time.com/collection/best-inventions-2022/6227290/hibob/|title=HiBob: The 200 Best Inventions of 2022|date=November 10, 2022|first=Ali |last=Withers|website=[[Time (magazine)|Time]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.israel21c.org/5-israeli-technologies-named-time-best-inventions-2022/|title=5 Israeli technologies named TIME best inventions 2022|first=Abigail Klein|last=Leichman|date=January 19, 2023|website=[[ISRAEL21c]]}}</ref> HiBob also appeared on ''[[Forbes]]''' Cloud 100 in both 2023 and 2024.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/lists/cloud100/|title=Forbes Cloud 100 2024 List|first1=Kenrick |last1=Cai |first2=Alex |last2=Konrad |website=[[Forbes]]}}</ref>

In 2024, HiBob acquired [[Tiger Global]]-backed Pento, a [[payroll automation]] platform based in [[London]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/bjuv8odo6|title=HR unicorn HiBob acquiring British payroll platform Pento for $40 million|date=February 13, 2024|first=Meir |last=Orbach|website=[[Calcalist]]}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.businessinsider.com/hr-unicorn-hibob-acquires-uk-payroll-startup-pento-tech-boom-2024-2|title=HiBob, a $2.7-billion HR unicorn, is acquiring Tiger Global-backed payroll startup Pento|first=Callum|last=Burroughs|date=February 13, 2024|website=[[Business Insider]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://tech.eu/2024/02/13/tiger-global-backed-pento-acquired-by-israeli-hr-platform-hibob/|title=Tiger Global-backed Pento acquired by Israeli HR platform HiBob |first=Dan |last=Taylor |date=February 13, 2024|website=Tech.eu}}</ref> In 2025, the company acquired Mosaic, a U.S.-based financial planning and analysis software company that utilizes artificial intelligence in [[financial management]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/ryvodwoyjl|title=HiBob acquires Mosaic for $35 million to merge HR and financial planning|date=February 13, 2025|first=Meir |last=Orbach|website=[[Calcalist]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fintechfutures.com/m-a/hibob-acquires-us-fintech-mosaic-to-integrate-ai-powered-financial-management-into-hr-platform|title=HiBob acquires US fintech Mosaic to integrate AI-powered financial management into HR platform |first=Tyler |last=Pathe |date=February 17, 2025 |website=FintechFutures}}</ref>

==Platform==
Bob is HiBob’s cloud-based [[Human Capital Management System|HCM]] and [[Human resources information systems|HRIS]] platform delivered as [[Software as a service|software-as-a-service]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=McQuarrie |first=Kylie |date=March 27, 2024 |title=Bob Review |url=https://www.techrepublic.com/article/bob-review/ |website=[[TechRepublic]]}}</ref> It is aimed at mid-market employers and used to manage multiple human resources functions.<ref name="Sawers2022" /> Bob supports core HR administration, workforce management, talent and engagement processes, compensation, analytics, payroll, benefits administration, automation, and integrations.<ref name="Sawers2022" /><ref name=":4" />

The platform also includes tools for hybrid-work scheduling and geographically distributed teams.<ref name="TIME">{{Cite web|url=https://time.com/collection/best-inventions-2022/6227290/hibob/|title=HiBob: The 200 Best Inventions of 2022|date=November 10, 2022|first=Ali |last=Withers|website=[[Time (magazine)|Time]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thetimes.com/business-money/entrepreneurs/article/hybrid-working-to-stay-with-us-for-ever-5wtp70c9n|title=Hybrid working to ‘stay with us for ever’|first=James|last=Hurley|date=June 4, 2023|website=[[The Times]]}}</ref> Following HiBob’s acquisition of Pento, Bob expanded its payroll automation capabilities.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bucholz |first=Lucy |date=2024-02-14 |title=HiBob CEO says Pento acquisition is ‘significant’ payroll services expansion |url=https://www.unleash.ai/artificial-intelligence/hibob-ceo-says-40m-pento-acquisition-is-significant-payroll-services-expansion/ |access-date= |website=UNLEASH |language=en-US}}</ref> The acquisition of Mosaic added financial-planning functionality, including tools for connecting HR data with budget modeling and workforce cost planning.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jennings |first=Mike |date=2026-04-20 |title=HiBob HR software review |url=https://www.techradar.com/pro/hibob-hr-software-review |access-date=2026-05-25 |website=TechRadar |language=en}}</ref>

AI-assisted reporting, including natural-language report generation was later integrated into the platform.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Harris |first=Stacey |last2=Seals |first2=Kim |date=2025-12-19 |title=Beyond the buzz: Inside AI-enabled HR functions |url=https://hrexecutive.com/beyond-the-buzz-inside-ai-enabled-hr-functions/ |access-date=2026-05-25 |website=HR Executive |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Rice |first=David |last2= |first2= |date=2026-04-20 |title=HiBob AI Features: From Employee Self-Service to Org-Wide Governance |url=https://peoplemanagingpeople.com/global-hr/hibob-ai-features-from-employee-self-service-to-org-wide-governance/ |access-date=2026-05-25 |website=People Managing People |language=en-US}}</ref>
